name: flowstate
description: FlowState 2.0 - Open-source productivity orchestration platform built on OpenCode
author: Luke Brevoort

scripts.predev:desktop: pnpm --filter @flowstate/desktop rebuild:native && pnpm -w --filter @flowstate/mcp-gmail build && pnpm -w --filter @flowstate/mcp-notion build && pnpm -w --filter @flowstate/mcp-gcal build && pnpm -w --filter @flowstate/mcp-system build && pnpm -w --filter @flowstate/mcp-canvas build
scripts.dev:desktop: pnpm --filter @flowstate/desktop exec concurrently "pnpm --filter @flowstate/desktop dev" "pnpm --filter @flowstate/desktop build:main && pnpm --filter @flowstate/desktop build:preload && pnpm --filter @flowstate/desktop exec electron dist/main/index.js"
scripts.pretest:mcp: pnpm -w --filter @flowstate/mcp-gmail build && pnpm -w --filter @flowstate/mcp-notion build && pnpm -w --filter @flowstate/mcp-gcal build && pnpm -w --filter @flowstate/mcp-system build && pnpm -w --filter @flowstate/mcp-canvas build
